rev.t:
Checked out the Pepperfry Furnitures today and was really impressed by the curated displays.
They have a fantastic range of contemporary furniture—the dark velvet armchairs …

The experience center of pepperfry is really nice. The collection is good. And more importantly the associate, Jashwant helped us in understanding the desired product required as per our requirement. This is a must visit place to get some good furniture.

The shop is right in the main road . Two wheeler parking space is available.
Shop is of 2 floors with more options for all kind of furniture. Just loved few items. …
